title: そんなおかわり、いらないし！

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's it for the extra math class! I hope I see better grades on the next quiz!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's finally over… That was the worst. My shoulders are so stiff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gotta hurry back and get some rest. Yaaawn… Sooo sleepy…

text_block_list.name: Teacher B
text_block_list.text: Oh, Jordan! I'm giving an extra chemistry class after this! You're coming today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Teacher C
text_block_list.text: Huh? But she has an extra classics lesson with me today… Oh well. Jordan, you'll just have to come once you're finished with chemistry!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Are you guys for real?! Come on, you can't all just decide to give me extra classes on a whim! Seriously!

text_block_list.name: Teachers
text_block_list.text: Your test scores are what decided things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The back-to-back extra classes may be a direct consequence of Tosen Jordan's own actions, but they still leave her feeling pretty down.
